sections.name: About Us
sections.copy: Goshen Farms Snacks & Treats Limited (also known as Goshen Farms Quick Bites Co) is a leading FoodTech company based in Alimosho, Lagos. Founded by a Beverage Tech Strategist with a passion for quality and innovation, we specialize in delivering fresh, delicious snacks and quick bites that satisfy your cravings while meeting the highest standards of hygiene and taste. Our mission is simple: to make nutritious, affordable snacking accessible to every Nigerian household. From our facility at 8 Omoyeni Street, AKESAN, Igando, we serve communities across Lagos with commitment, care, and consistency. At Goshen Farms, every bite tells a story of freshness and excellence.

sections.name: Our Products & Services
sections.copy:
We offer an extensive range of snacks and quick bites perfect for every occasion:

**Premium Snack Packages** - Carefully curated selections of Nigerian favorites including plantain chips, chin-chin, coconut candy, and groundnuts. Perfect for parties, offices, or personal enjoyment.

**Quick Bites on Demand** - Fresh puff-puff, meat pie, fish rolls, sausage rolls, and samosas prepared daily and delivered hot to your location.

**Beverage Solutions** - Complementary drink options including zobo, chapman, fresh fruit juices, and soft drinks to pair perfectly with our snacks.

**Bulk & Corporate Orders** - Special packages for events, conferences, staff meetings, and celebrations. We handle orders of any size with professionalism and punctuality.

**Custom Snack Boxes** - Personalized gift boxes and hampers for special occasions, branded packaging available for corporate gifts.

All our products are made with quality ingredients, packaged hygienically, and delivered fresh. We combine traditional Nigerian recipes with modern food safety standards.

sections.name: Get In Touch
sections.copy:
Ready to enjoy fresh, delicious snacks? Contact Goshen Farms Snacks & Treats Limited today!

Visit our facility at 8 Omoyeni Street, AKESAN, Igando, Alimosho L.G.A, Lagos, or reach us via phone and WhatsApp for orders, inquiries, and special requests. We're here to serve you with the best snacks Lagos has to offer.

Whether you need a small pack for personal enjoyment or bulk orders for your next event, Goshen Farms Quick Bites Co is just a call away. Let us make your snacking experience memorable!

Business Hours: Monday - Saturday, 8:00 AM - 7:00 PM
Sunday: By appointment only

We deliver across Alimosho and surrounding areas in Lagos. Minimum order may apply for delivery outside Igando axis.
